=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1596-1634 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rename-on-collision check (`git cat-file -e "FETCH_HEAD:${REPORT_FILE}"`) only looks at the target branch tip, so it cannot see a report still waiting in an open or auto-merging PR from an earlier serialized run. A second same-day run reuses the `analysis/workflow-optimization-<date>.md` path on its own run branch.
  WHY: When the first PR merges, the second PR has an add/add conflict. GitHub disables auto-merge, `--match-head-commit` blocks any later merge, the report never lands, and deep-audit for that run is skipped. Push mode avoided this with the rename loop, and multiple runs per day are normal (sonnet also cites lines 1253-1258 and 70-72; glm also cites lines 1494-1495 and 70-72). All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1711-1728,1808 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the direct `gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit` is refused (for example, required checks are pending), the run records `pr_auto_merge` (or `pr_open`). The deep-audit `if:` at line 1808 allows only `''`, `'pushed'` or `'pr_merged'`, so deep-audit is skipped, and api-redundancy (line 2414/2415, `needs: deep-audit`) is skipped with it.
  WHY: With the default `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=true` on protected branches, this is the steady-state outcome. Nothing re-runs either audit after auto-merge completes, so both stop running without any signal. Severity: MAJOR from all reviewers; confidence ranges 3-4 (glm=3).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1723-1728 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The run exits 0 at line 1739 in the `pr_auto_merge` and `pr_open` outcomes. `.github/workflows/comprehensive-test-and-release.yml` lines 208-213, 224-228 and 262 wait only for `RUN_CONCLUSION == success`, then pick the newest `workflow-optimization-*.md` already on the branch.
  WHY: In every outcome except `pr_merged`, Phase 3 (`REPORT_FILE_INPUT`, line 282) sends the orchestrator the previous run's stale report with no error or warning. The PR description, changelog and README do not mention this consumer.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1689-1693 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Report PRs opened with `GH_PAT` (line 1466) fire `pull_request` events, which start the full PR CI suite and the AI review/autofix pipeline. No skip gate exists for the `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-` head ref: `review_autofix.yml:1383, 1396` gate only `auto/update-workflows-` and `auto/forward-merge-stable-`, and `ci.yml:290` exempts only `orchestrator/project-` and `auto/forward-merge-stable-`.
  WHY: The report is far above `AUTOFIX_SKIP_MAX_ADDITIONS`. Each dispatch therefore costs extra CI and review runs, and the autofix editor can push `[ai-autofix]` commits that rewrite the LLM-generated report before auto-merge, changing what apply-analysis consumers read. The changelog, agents fragment and README do not document this. Severity: MAJOR from all reviewers; confidence ranges 3-4 (gemini=4).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1701-1704,1742,1763-1796 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `gh pr create` fails, `commit_report` exits 1 without writing delivery outputs. The `if: always()` Telegram step still sends "Workflow log analysis completed", with a `REPORT_URL` blob link built from `GITHUB_REF_NAME`.
  WHY: The report exists only on the run-unique branch, so recipients get a success-style message whose link does not contain the report. All reviewers rated it NIT; confidence ranges 3-5.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1466,1721-1728 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `GH_PAT` is unset, the `github.token` fallback opens a PR that triggers no workflow runs. Its required checks never report, so `--auto` succeeds but the PR never merges, while the run logs a normal-looking `pr_auto_merge`.
  WHY: In protected repos, unmergeable report PRs and their `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-*` branches pile up with no supersession, cleanup or distinguishing warning. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1633-1634 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The run-branch push uses an unconditional `git push --force`, which silently overwrites any other writer or retried attempt on the same branch name.
  WHY: `--force-with-lease` would surface the divergence. The unconditional force defeats the `--match-head-commit` intent of "never deliver a head someone else pushed". Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1715-1728 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `report_head_sha` is captured once and reused by both `--match-head-commit` merge attempts.
  WHY: If the head SHA moves between attempts, the second attempt fails with a head-SHA mismatch and the run falls into `pr_open` with a `::warning::`, even though the head is legitimate.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1722-1728 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The post-merge `git push origin --delete "${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}"` is not retried after a transient push error.
  WHY: Each failed delete leaves an `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-*` branch behind, and nothing else cleans them up, so they accumulate.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1486-1491 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An unrecognized or misspelled `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR` value silently selects PR mode, because the `case` statement has only `false|0|no|off` arms and no warning arm.
  WHY: An operator who intends legacy push delivery gets a PR with no diagnostic. The same issue also appears as a hardening suggestion (not a scored finding) from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash.
- changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md, agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:file names | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both new fragments leave out the `9117-` issue-number prefix that the `<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` convention requires.
  WHY: The fragments still fold, but a slug-only name can collide across issues and breaks the convention that fragment paths are unique and traceable.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "This PR must be production-safe on its own, without any other phase merged." (issue #9117, Discipline section)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 1802-1811 (the `deep-audit` `if:` predicate) and lines 1715-1728 (the merge-attempt block), or an equivalent guard
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The `deep-audit` `if:` allows only `''`, `'pushed'` or `'pr_merged'`, not `'pr_auto_merge'`. With required checks, every run reaches `'pr_auto_merge'`, so deep-audit and api-redundancy never run. P1 introduces this regression on its own.
- requirement: "Implement Phase P1 of docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md ... Follow the plan's P1 steps exactly" and "Add the contract tests the plan lists for P1."
  expected_change_site: The P1 Implementation Steps and Tests sections of docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md (on branch claude/nifty-bell-td94mh / PR #9115)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The plan file is not in the checkout, so the diff cannot be checked against the P1 steps or Decisions D1-D7. The delivered change matches the issue's explicit requirements. The reviewer recorded this only as unverifiable, not as a confirmed gap (NIT).

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:lines 1723-1728 (commit_report), exit 0 at line 1739; .github/workflows/comprehensive-test-and-release.yml lines 208-213, 224-228, 262, 282 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A successful run no longer means the report is on the target branch. comprehensive-test-and-release Phase 2 waits only for `RUN_CONCLUSION == success`, then picks the newest `workflow-optimization-*.md`, which is the previous run's stale report.
  WHY: In every outcome except `pr_merged`, the orchestrator is sent an old analysis doc with no error. The PR description, changelog and README mention only that deep-audit is skipped. Suggested fixes: fail or emit a hard signal on non-`pr_merged`, or have the caller read `report_delivery`.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:Lines 1253-1258, 1609-1622, 1633-1634, 70-72 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The collision check inspects only the target branch tip, so a second same-day run reuses the path of a report still waiting in a PR.
  WHY: The first merge causes an add/add conflict, auto-merge is disabled, `--match-head-commit` blocks later merges, and the report never lands. Suggested git-only fix: also check `refs/heads/auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-*`.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:Lines 1701-1704, 1763-1790 (Telegram, `if: always()`), line 1784 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When PR creation fails, Telegram still sends "completed" with a blob link to the dispatch branch, but the report exists only on the run branch.
  WHY: Operators get a success-style message with a 404 link. This is the same shape as the old push-failure path.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:Line 1466, Lines 1689-1693; .github/workflows/internal-review.yml lines 10-12, 56; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 1383, 1396 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: PRs opened with GH_PAT start PR CI and the AI review/autofix pipeline, and nothing gates the `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-` head ref.
  WHY: The autofix editor can push `[ai-autofix]` commits that rewrite the report before auto-merge, and every dispatch costs an extra review cycle. None of this is documented. Suggested fix: skip review_autofix for `^auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$` or document the behavior.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: "Implement Phase P1 of docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md ... Follow the plan's P1 steps exactly" and "Add the contract tests the plan lists for P1."
  Expected change site: The P1 Implementation Steps and Tests sections of docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md (on branch claude/nifty-bell-td94mh / PR #9115).
  Evidence of absence: The plan is not in the checkout, so it is unverifiable. The explicit issue requirements are met, and no concrete unmet requirement can be named.
